source: 2016-2025 archived KRX raw prices for the eight continuously observed stocks
foldRule: For each test year Y, fit candidates before Y-1; validate on Y-1 with labels available before Y; choose lowest validation MAE; refit the chosen configuration on prior eligible rows and score Y. Training labels must be available before validation starts.
target: Verified-split-aware entry open to 63rd observed date close percent price change, excluding cash dividends
selectionMetric: validation MAE in percentage points, with candidate order as tie break
reporting: Report every yearly test fold, baseline and validation-selected candidate; do not select the best configuration from test years after viewing them.
limitations: All past years have been seen in earlier exploratory work. This is a repeatable rolling diagnostic, not a pristine final holdout or a strict point-in-time approved dataset.
